title: Exceptional Sets for Quasiconformal Mappings in General Metric Spaces II
summary: A homemorphism between domains in $\mathbb R^n$, $n\ge 2$ is quasiconformal, with its intricate analytic and geometric consequences, if the (pointwise) linear dilatation -- a purely metric quantity -- is uniformly bounded. Gehring proved that it will suffice to verify the uniform bound up to a set of measure zero as long as we can show that the dilatation is finite outside a subset of finite Hausdorff--$(n-1)$ measure.
